title: Let the Name become your family
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 273
summary: This section opens by describing the God-conscious being as one who loves the One alone and lives in that nearness. It keeps narrowing support down to Naam, until even family, wakefulness, and permanence are redefined by it.
whyItMatters: This is for anyone who feels impressionable, rootless, or easily claimed by whatever is nearest. Stayed with, it teaches a form of belonging that ego cannot counterfeit.
takeaway: Hold onto this: take the Name as support, family, and lasting nearness.

lines.translation: The God-conscious being loves the One Lord alone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਬਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੰਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: braham giaanee kai basai prabh sa(n)g ||
lines.translation: The God-conscious being dwells with God.
The God-conscious being takes the Naam as his Support.
The God-conscious being has the Naam as his Family.
The God-conscious being is awake and aware, forever and ever.
The God-conscious being renounces his proud ego.
In the mind of the God-conscious being, there is supreme bliss.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: braham giaanee kai ghar sadhaa ana(n)dh ||
lines.translation: In the home of the God-conscious being, there is everlasting bliss.
The God-conscious being dwells in peaceful ease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak braham giaanee kaa nahee binaas ||5||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the God-conscious being shall never perish. ||5||

structure: First, it starts with singular love rather than divided loyalty.
Then, it turns support and family into what is received through Naam.
Finally, it ends by pairing wakefulness and the renunciation of pride with a life that does not perish.
